paragraphs: At the start of a shift, inspect equipment and verify instruments and liquid levels. At midday, adjust separator speed and check filter pressure and clarity. Walk the floor listening for unusual sounds and recording blockage points. When an exception occurs, stabilize operations before reporting it, then document the incident. Before handoff, organize the hazard list and brief central control.
